cases.scope: Actual recorded Sonoma building footprint translated to domain centre; assigned flat height and three synthetic canopy patches. Canopy positions are deliberately assigned, not measured from this property. Generic wood building/vegetation, no interiors/trunks/groundcover/embers.
cases.measurement_note: Sparse1m vertical wall samples and approximately1m roof samples; global surface maximum and full raw boundary fields retain any-part ignition criterion. Staircase0.5m voxel footprint, solid extrusion without interior. Roof patch weights approximate edge coverage.
